input_grid.description: Rectangular matrix; each cell is an integer color 0–9.

my_rule.description: The rule you currently hold, in one sentence.

rival_rule.description: The strongest competing reading of the evidence so far, in one sentence.

predicted_output.description: The output your rule gives for this input.

rival_output.description: The output the rival reading gives for this input.

tools.description: Provide only an input grid. The environment applies the verifier and shows the resulting gold input-output pair to the student. Also give the most plausible misreading a student might hold, and the output it would give for this input (my_rule is the true rule; predicted_output may repeat the true output).
